title: Pay too much for coffee
description: Pay more than $8 for a coffee

title: Look for a sharehouse
description:
Go to an open home for a rental with at least two bedrooms.
You must spend at least 5 minutes looking around.

title: Tim tam slam
description: Successfully drink hot chocolate through a tim tam.

title: Look for Harold
description:
Spend ten minutes looking for Harold Holt in the ocean.
You must have a clear view of the Ocean the entire time you look.
If you find him, you immediately win the game.

title: Cross the same river twice
description:
Cross a river twice.
The river must have a name.
You must cross the river at two different points, using two different methods of transport.
Acceptable methods are: walking, cycling, tram, train, bus, or boat.
You may leave the neighbourhood during this challenge, but you must start and end the challenge in the neighbourhood you are claiming.

title: Find something for Kate
description: Find an item specifically for a person named Kate. The item must feature the name "Kate".

title: See a goal
description:
Watch someone score an AFL.
The goal must be scored with real AFL goals by a real AFL ball.

title: Sing happy birthday to a tree
description:
Visit a tree which was planted on today's date.
Sing happy birthday to the tree.
Use the Urban Forest Tree Database.

title: Predict the train doors
description:
Stand at the place where the train doors will open.
Only one team member may attempt this challenge at a time.
If any part of the train entryway is directly in front of your eyeline when the doors open, you succeed. If not, you may attempt again with another train.

title: Rhino on a skateboard
description:
Put a Rhino on a skateboard.
The Rhino must be a clear depiction of a rhino. You may not make your own rhino.
The skateboard must be something with wheels. It must be able to freely roll with the rhino on top.

title: Complete a Trainle
description:
Complete a Trainle in 6 guesses or less.
You may not use your phone to look at train stations.
https://trainle.fun/

title: Go one kilometre
description:
One team member must pick a random direction by spinning around with eyes closed.
Find the point exactly 1km in that direction using google maps.
Go to within 10 metres of that point.
If that point is in another neighbourhood, claim both neighbourhoods.
If the point is legally or practically inaccessible, spin again.

title: Try tricky train track trials
description:
Go to a metro station that has the same first letter as the first name of a member of your team.
You must use the team member's most commonly used name. 
Describe the metro station using three adjectives which start with the same letter.
